review:
A traditional 100-line fruit machine with modern graphics, plus a panel showing your best win and best multiplier from the session.

The wild covers everything except scatters, and three scatters anywhere pay. No complicated bonus – just steady, low-stress spins. Medium-low volatility, a 3,000x max and an excellent 97.16% RTP. One of the best-value classics BGaming makes.
pros: Excellent 97.16% RTP – among the highest published
Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
